description: Runs from the scheduled GitLab CI job `renovate` (SCHEDULE=RENOVATE, .gitlab/ci/01_init.yml). Setup: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md § Dependency updates.

customManagers.description: versions.env: every toolchain/base-image version, annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm updates into a single MR per week.
Major npm updates open individually so breaking-change review stays scoped.
packageManager and engines.node are DERIVED from versions.env by scripts/sync-versions.sh — never bump them directly.
pnpm / Corepack / Node / Alpine feed derived package.json fields: the MR fails CI job `versions in sync` until someone runs `pnpm sync:versions` on its branch.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Derived fields: check out this branch, run `pnpm sync:versions` (then `mise install`), commit, and push. For node/alpine, first confirm the `<NODE_MAJOR>-alpine<ALPINE_VERSION>` tag exists on BOTH `dhi.io/node` and stock `node`.

packageRules.description: fnox / age carry sha256 pins that Renovate cannot compute: CI fails `install-fnox: sha256 mismatch` until they are updated.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Update the matching `*_SHA256_LINUX_X86_64` / `*_SHA256_LINUX_AARCH64` pins in `versions.env` from the release assets' digests, then run `mise install`.
